alternatives.label: Kitchen Ticket Ledger
alternatives.reason: Warm paper and charcoal ink give high-contrast, kitchen-order-ticket clarity, with tomato red reserved strictly for urgent pickups and set against condensed headings and tabular mono quantities so portion counts and pickup-by times read like kitchen tickets.

alternatives.label: Monsoon Dispatch Dusk

typography.font_family: Nunito Sans, Source Sans 3, Segoe UI, sans-serif
typography.font_family_heading: Nunito, Nunito Sans, Segoe UI, sans-serif

alternatives.reason: A deep slate-teal base with muted sea-green surfaces, soft amber accents, and gently glowing status tones keeps contrast comfortable for low-light evening runs while a rounded humanist sans and generous tap targets let volunteers scan routes one-handed.

alternatives.label: Civic Ration Record

typography.font_family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
typography.font_family_mono: IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace

alternatives.reason: A bone page with sage-grey panels, ink-navy type and a transitional serif for headings gives the calm, ledger-like feel of an audit record, so confirmed rescues and their labelled assumptions read as trustworthy documentation.

alternatives.label: Countdown Signal Board
alternatives.reason: A near-black, high-contrast interface with one saturated signal yellow reserved for claim windows and reservation timers, set in bold condensed type on flat hard-edged surfaces, so time-critical actions stay legible and unmistakable on a phone in bright outdoor light.
